title: Why not put everything in Neo4j?

sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: The ADR assigns semantic context to Neo4j and local operational records to SQLite. This is a responsibility boundary, not a claim that Neo4j cannot store logs.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: Start with responsibility and evidence before choosing technology.
